title: IdFate tracker in MemoryBackend correctly implements RFC 8620 §5.6 deduplication
description: tests/common/mod.rs:93-97 — the created+destroyed-in-window → omit logic is correct per RFC 8620 §5.6 and easy to get wrong. Most simple implementations just union all created/updated/destroyed lists without deduplication. Keep this and add a test specifically for the cross-window case if it doesn't exist.
